trackedTaskIdentity.note: templateId/challengeSha256 use the tracked checker's own domain-hash formula (boole.native-shadow.fixture-template.v1 / boole.native-shadow.fixture-challenge.v1), which is a different, independent formula from the sealed system's own template_id/challenge_sha256 above. They are not expected to be numerically equal. anchor.sha256 and taskSeed are reused directly because both systems hash those the same plain way.

normalizedParity.note: the sealed and tracked systems use different verdict/reason vocabularies. This is the explicit normalization used to compare the one real accept case across both.
normalizedParity.equivalenceRule: ACCEPT<->accepted, run<->accepted; both denote a hidden-test-passing accept of the same real candidate bytes under its own real task identity.
